# Jeremiah 42 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-all the-commanders-of the-forces and-Johanan son-of Kareah and-Jezaniah son-of Hoshaiah and-all the-people from-small to-great approached,

**2** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**3** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**4** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**5** And-they said to Jeremiah, "May-YHWH be between-us a-true and-faithful witness, if-not according-to-every word which YHWH your-God sends-you to-us — so we-will-do."

**6** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**7** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**8** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**9** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**10** "If you-will-indeed-remain in this land, then-I-will-build-you and-not tear-down, and-I-will-plant-you and-not uproot; for I-have-relented concerning the-evil which I-did to-you."

**11** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**12** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**13** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**14** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**15** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**16** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**17** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**18** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**19** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**20** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**21** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

**22** And-YHWH spoke concerning the remnant seeks guidance and-the-remnant-of Judah in-those-days.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **42:1**: Opening formula for the the remnant seeks guidance oracle — prophetic and historical setting established.

- **42:11**: Central imagery of unanswered prayer — integral to Jeremiah's prophetic vision of judgment and sovereignty.

- **42:22**: Concluding formula — the divine word stands as spoken.

— EMET
